subject: Processor roster handoff & KMS sourcing question
messages:
From: Alice Murphy <alice.murphy@finport.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: legalops@finport.com
Date: 2027-06-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Processor roster handoff & KMS sourcing question

Hi Jonas / Lauren,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're documenting the vendor handoff for our integration and have a couple of asks before we finalize the DPA annex:

- Can you provide an up-to-date list of processors Redwood will engage for request routing, logging, and telemetry (production and staging)? We need service names, countries of processing, and whether they hold encryption keys.
- Second, does Redwood use a managed KMS for any customer-specific keys, or do you rely on customer-provided keys/HSMs for the tokenization/encryption paths? If managed, which provider and region?

If you can share a simple matrix (service / purpose / country / key custody) that will help our procurement and security teams do a quick gap assessment. Ideally we'd have this by EOD Monday-ish — FinPort is aiming to close the procurement checklist next week.

Attaching our template for a roster to make it easier.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Murphy
Senior Security PM | FinPort, Inc.
alice.murphy@finport.com
Attachment: finport_roster_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Murphy <alice.murphy@finport.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Processor roster handoff & KMS sourcing question

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the note and the template. We've started a matrix and I'm attaching a version populated with our current processors for routing, observability, and storage. Quick summary up front:

- Routing/proxy: EdgeRelay (US, EU) — no customer keys, TLS in transit only.
- Logging/observability: LogStream Inc. (US) — ingestion only; logs are pseudonymized; customer data retention configurable.
- Model hosting/cache: Dedicated pools managed by Redwood (multi-region) — we do not surface customer-specific encryption keys by default.
- KMS: Redwood supports two modes: managed KMS (Google Cloud KMS for hosted customers in our GCP regions) and customer-managed keys via BYOK/HSM integrations for Dedicated/Private customers.

For FinPort specifically, per our conversation, we can enable BYOK for the Dedicated cluster and provide key-wrapping proofs. I'll flag Legal for any wording changes to the DPA.

Attached: subprocessor_change_matrix.xlsx (populated), kms_screenshot.png (example console showing managed KMS mode).

Next steps I propose:
1) Lauren to route the matrix to Legal and PMs for quick review.
2) If FinPort needs BYOK, we can scope the work and map timelines (should be a few weeks for Dedicated onboarding + key exchange).

Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Attachment: subprocessor_change_matrix.xlsx, kms_screenshot.png

Subject: Fwd: Processor roster handoff & KMS sourcing question

Forwarding the matrix from Jonas for your legal review — tagging FinPort LegalOps.

Lauren notes: the matrix includes third parties that are used in staging only (we marked those as "staging" under environment). For production processors we have at most one EU-resident logging provider (LogStream Inc., Ireland) and managed KMS in us-west-2 for hosted out of our US region.

On the BYOK ask: we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private customers; FinPort has indicated they prefer BYOK. If Legal is okay with the standard BYOK clause, we can include the existing annex. If you need stricter custody language or an HSM attestation, we should capture that as a DPA redline.

Hi Alice / team —

Thanks for the matrix and the clarifications. Legal reviewed the attached roster and the BYOK options. High-level response and requested edits below: 

1) Processor roster: the entries look complete for the initial assessment. We asked Jonas to flag any "transient" vendors (staging/test infra) and to add the export-control country list for each vendor — that helps our export/transfer clause checks.

2) KMS / key custody: Redwood's two-mode approach is acceptable. For FinPort's procurement, we can commit to BYOK/HSM for Dedicated as an operational control. We need the exact KMS provider, key wrap algorithm, and whether the key material ever leaves the HSM in plaintext documented in the annex.

3) DPA redlines: attached is a redlined DPA with two modest asks: (a) add an explicit BYOK appendix that states key custody guarantees for Dedicated customers and (b) include a short schedule for evidence (KMS screenshots and HSM attestation) during onboarding.

Please review the redlines and confirm whether FinPort wants the standard BYOK clause or requires an HSM-attested flow. If you're good, we can push the redlined DPA to DocuSign (link below) and plan a BYOK enablement call with our infra team.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC-FF-2027-06
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/finport/subprocessor-matrix

Attachments: redlined_dpa_finport_v2.docx (redlines), kms_screenshot.png (matches earlier screenshot)

Thanks,
